_evidence: 0x0040ea09 and 0x0040ea46 read only byte +0x415 of the car record in ESI (shr 1 -> order index bl). Its only writer, 0x00408f42, stores 2*i (i = the car's position 0..21 in the 0x0066fe3c list) or 0, so the game passes even values 0..42; a few odd/high bytes are kept (bl up to 127 stays inside the varied order span of carno_0066ff6c), so the domain is a superset of the callers'.
